description_en: Modifies all parameters of a custom WUYING Workspace template

kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-template --template-id b-0caoeogs88y00000 --template-name My_cloud_desktop_template_001 --description testDescription --system-disk-size 80 --system-disk-performance-level AutoPL --data-disk-list Size=40 PerformanceLevel=example-string --image-id m-gx2x1dhsmusr20000 --policy-group-id pg-gx2x1dhsmthe90000 --default-language zh-CN --timer-group-id bcc-dweha00000 --resource-group-id rg-a5fqjjqaejt000 --resource-tag-list Value=design Key=department --region-config-list OfficeSiteId=cn-hangzhou+dir-7090000 SnapshotPolicyId=sp-35fvn8m200000 VolumeEncryptionEnable=false ResourceInstanceType=eds.enterprise_office.8c16g VolumeEncryptionKey=a7b3c0c8-b3a2-4876-b1cc-116dddc90000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou SubnetId=vsw-adjrehad10000 --site-config-list SiteId=example-string AppRuleId=example-string --charge-type example-string --period 1 --period-unit example-string --auto-pay true --auto-renew true --user-duration 1 --post-paid-after-used-up true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTemplate

parameters.help_en: The template ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.description_en:
The name of the template. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It must be 2 to 126 characters in length.

- It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- It can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It cannot contain periods (.).
parameters.description_zh:
模板的名称。必须符合以下要求：

- 长度2~126个英文或中文字符。
- 必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
- 可以包含字母、数字、汉字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或短划线（-），不支持点号（.）。

parameters.description_en:
The description of the template. The description must meet the following requirements:

- It must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, spaces, and special characters. Use line breaks to start a new line.
parameters.description_zh:
模板的描述。必须符合以下要求：

- 长度2~256个字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
- 支持中文、英文、数字、空格和特殊符号，使用回车换行。

parameters.description_en:
The size of the system disk. Unit: GiB. The value must be between 40 and 500, inclusive. The step size is 10 GiB.

> The system disk size cannot be smaller than the size of the image.
parameters.description_zh:
系统盘大小。单位：GiB。取值范围: 40~500，每10GiB为一个步长。

> 系统盘大小不能小于配置的镜像大小。
